name: github-enterprise-setup
description: Copilot CLI plugin for setting up and administering GitHub Enterprise Cloud with data residency (GHE.com). Guides enterprise admins through trial provisioning, Enterprise Managed Users (EMU) configuration, IdP integration (Entra ID/Okta/PingFederate), action policies, organization setup, security hardening, and repository migration. Based on https://docs.github.com/en/enterprise-cloud@latest/admin/data-residency/getting-started-with-data-residency-for-github-enterprise-cloud

prerequisites.description: This plugin requires the GitHub CLI for API operations on GHE.com instances.
